description: Event payload raised by TmChart when a series (multi-dataset legend) or a single value (per-value legend) is toggled through the interactive legend. Reports which legend item changed and whether it is now hidden.

members.name: Index
members.description: Zero-based index of the toggled legend item (the dataset index for a multi-series legend, or the value index for a per-value legend).

members.name: Label
members.description: Display label of the toggled legend item.

members.name: Hidden
members.description: True when the series or value is now hidden; false when it has been re-shown.
